s.n: Last crop corn on the cob
s.note: the farms where corn is the only crop left
s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes. Brush with 50g butter mixed with 1 tsp smoked paprika and lime zest, then char on a hot grill. Sprinkle with salt and 30g finely grated parmesan.

s.note: the dust storms that roll over the farm
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil and tip into a large bowl. Boil 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup for 4 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in half a tsp bicarb soda, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp sea salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss to coat. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break into clusters.

m.note: dinner at the farmhouse table with Murph and Tom
m.how: Poach 800g chicken thighs and shred. Soften a sliced leek in butter, add 2 tbsp flour, 200ml stock and 200ml cream, then the chicken, 200g corn kernels and thyme. Tip into a dish, top with 2 sheets shortcrust and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: the corn farm before Cooper leaves
w.how: Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 15 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 250g caster sugar, 60g melted butter, 2 tbsp plain flour, 250ml buttermilk, 1 tsp vanilla and a good grating of nutmeg until smooth. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool completely. Serve with whipped cream and fresh berries.

d.note: the beer on the porch at dusk
d.how: Frost four glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Dissolve 80g sugar in 80ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 4 lemons and mix the juice with the syrup and 300ml cold soda water. Half fill each glass with cold lager, about 190ml, then top with the lemonade. Add a lemon wheel and serve on the porch.
